name: Voxel Meshing via Compute Shader
definition: A technique that converts a 3D voxel grid into a triangle mesh using a compute shader. It processes voxels column-by-column (along the Y-axis) to generate quads for exposed faces, using indirect draw commands to handle variable output counts without host-side buffer management.
summary: Voxel meshing via compute shader converts voxel grids to triangle meshes using GPU-side atomic counters and indirect draw calls, eliminating host-side buffer management.
